notes: Dated Dec 31 pack. Concept 6's partygoer is the costume and identity reference; Basic Mari supplies only framing, scale, baseline, and pixel style. Each story was generated as its own four-beat transparent strip, then normalized into four 128 x 192 cells.

prompts.prompt: Match the left figure from concept 6: adult feminine chibi Professor Mari with voluminous orange-blonde curls, bright blue eyes, black rectangular glasses, sparkly navy star-speck sweater, dark grey jeans, black-and-white sneakers, blue paper party hat with gold stars, and red party cup. Cheerful house-party energy, crisp Basic-Mari-family pixel art, full body, transparent background.

Four-beat transparent pixel-art strips, one action per strip: slowly chew a chip by the snack bowl and get an idea; browse a party playlist on her phone and find the song; arrange red cups into a pong triangle and nod; write her name and a heart on her red cup, cap the marker, and show it. Exact concept-6 party outfit and identity throughout.

Four-beat transparent pixel-art strips, one action per strip: untangle fairy lights, find and replace the dead bulb, then glow; take a party selfie, flash, check it, and pose again; watch the midnight countdown on her phone while tapping her foot and readying a party horn; offer a second red cup toward the viewer and wait for a clink. Exact concept-6 party outfit and identity throughout.

Four-beat transparent pixel-art strips, one action per strip: pull a party popper, explode confetti, jump and cheer; miss a pong shot, retrieve the ball, aim and retry; watch a popper fizzle, receive one sad confetti piece, shrug with a drooping hat; bop, sip from the red cup, dance-step and raise the cup. Exact concept-6 party outfit and identity throughout.
